name: grill-to-spec
description: Codex plugin for grilling requirements, generating PRD.json, decomposing task artifacts, evaluating output quality, and using vendored Spec Kit assets locally.

interface.shortDescription: Turn grilled context into PRD.json, task artifacts, tasks, evals, and local Spec Kit handoffs.
interface.longDescription: Runs a phase-gated Codex workflow: grill the user one question at a time, synthesize a machine-actionable PRD.json, decompose the PRD into traceable task artifacts with tasks, evaluate artifact quality, and save a Spec Kit handoff archive with vendored scripts and templates.
defaultPrompt: Create PRD.json, task artifacts, and evals.
Create a Spec-Kit archive with the eval report.
